title: Preallocate DELETE schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when DELETE builds schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added delete_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.

result: DELETE schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving schema lookup, delete planning, secondary index cleanup, and SQL DML behavior.
